# Standard input has no package, so its author CSS is not known to be
# complete: a <style> element is not all the CSS a page may load. An
# element with a class is unsure, so the section holding it is left as
# written, whole (its sibling too); a list without one, like main's, is
# indented.

stdin page.gohtml
muxt fmt
cmp stdout want.gohtml

-- page.gohtml --
<style>p{color:red}</style>
<section>
<div class="code">
  keep   me
</div>
<p>x</p>
</section>
<main>
<p>y</p>
</main>
-- want.gohtml --
<style>p{color:red}</style>
<section>
<div class="code">
  keep   me
</div>
<p>x</p>
</section>
<main>
	<p>y</p>
</main>
